cuts.item: TC Pacios costs and decommissioning expenses removed from the operating budget

statements.statement: Tier 1 override appropriation figure given as $2,354,000 and change, before rounding for the ballot
Tier 2 override appropriation figure given as $3,245,245, likely rounded to $3.3 million for the ballot question
Select Board voted to include Article M, the FY2027 Proposition 2½ override, in the warrant
FY2027 capital program total of $1,830,000, funded from raise-and-appropriate, the special purpose stabilization fund, and free cash
$991,627 of free cash to be used toward the FY2027 capital program
$250,000 of free cash appropriated to the general stabilization fund
$250,000 of free cash appropriated to the health insurance special purpose stabilization fund
$27,500 for special assistance costs to be funded via transfer from the assessor's overlay
Board finalized the override ballot amounts at $2.4 million (tier 1) and $3.3 million (tier 2), rounded up from the appropriation figures
Select Board voted to include the two-tier Proposition 2½ override question on the annual town election ballot
A member expressed serious concerns about the sustainability and affordability of both override tiers, citing new positions created even in the proposed balanced budget
Chair stated no new positions were added without cuts elsewhere; a fourth firefighter shift was included along with extensive cuts across several departments
